Slim Claude MD 2.0.0 is a major release evolving the skill for structured, sustainable project memory management.

- Supports both initializing new project memory files and restructuring bloated ones (“NEW” and “EXISTING” modes).
- Produces a concise, router-style CLAUDE.md index; lives secrets in a gitignored CLAUDE.local.md.
- Moves deep-dive docs and recaps into a topical docs/ directory tree.
- Automates setup of gitignore, directory structure, and credential best practices.
- Includes built-in housekeeping and session protocols to prevent future bloat.
- Provides user-facing prompts, verification steps, and clear handoff instructions.
